name: game-authoring-review
goal: Preserve focused authoring edits and paid image results, scope traces by view, recover failed project creation, and generate correctly dimensioned game scaffolds.

steps.title: Identify the failing behavior, expected behavior, and reproduction.
steps.evidence: Focused checkpoint and mechanics text is lost before blur; trace entries cross view boundaries; guidance edits drop a paid result; failed generation or Git blocks retry; generated 3D views and scaffold guidance incorrectly say 2D/apps.

steps.title: Explain why existing standardized tests missed the bug; name the scenario, fixture, lifecycle or assertion gap and reusable test change.
steps.evidence: Existing authoring tests blurred inputs before saving and did not reuse checkpoint ids across views. Image tests changed selection but not in-flight guidance. Creation tested only success/existing folders; generator tests did not assert dimensions or accurate info guidance. Extend those same standard matrices.

steps.title: Strengthen the existing standardized test; commit it before repair, run it failing with loop record --phase red, and preserve the assertion.
steps.evidence: At d3710b16e, the clean snapshot reproduces incorrect 3D scaffold guidance/dimensions, EACCES masking and partial-folder retry failure, swallowed credential diagnostics, focused edits not dirty, cross-view trace entries, dropped image results and repeated same-image reads. The failing assertion and test corpus are preserved in the paired record.

steps.title: Implement the smallest repair without weakening the regression test.
steps.evidence: Report edits on input while preserving raw focused drafts; filter trace by view; retain same-checkpoint paid results with earlier-guidance notice and avoid redundant reads. Roll back only owned partial creations with async Git, carry project dimensions into scaffolds, and generate seed documents from one source.

steps.title: Rerun the same unchanged regression test at a separate fix commit with loop record --phase green; preserve passing proof.
steps.evidence: Unchanged paired tests pass at 3527b694fa062910386334b5cd1569dac2f16897 on the same Darwin/arm64 profile. Inspected matching focused steps capture: Unsaved changes is visible and Save enabled before blur. Creation, credentials and image lifecycle assertions pass.

steps.title: Run relevant project checks and affected UI browser flows with fresh inspected screenshots and no unexpected browser errors; preserve diagnostics and keep pending until proof passes.
